text: The Applicant for 2217 Kingston Road has requested Scarborough Community Council to exempt their property from the following by-law requirements: City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 1.2B(1) – Restrictions on Fences; Height. The proposed fence in the rear yard on the east side of the property will have a height of 3.26 meters. This is higher than the allowable 2.5 meters. AND City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 1.2C(1) – Restrictions on Fences; Open-Fence Construction Required. The proposed fence in the rear yard on the southeast side of the property will be within 2.4 meters of a driveway and not made of open construction. Municipal Licensing and Standards Division has inspected the subject property.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Granted a fence exemption permit to the property owner of 2217 Kingston Road and that at such time as replacement of the fence is required, the installation comply with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences, or its successor by-law.
